title: FLV video: dimensions hardcoded 320×240 in FLA import (never extracted from bitstream)
description: In flash8-import.ts, when a Media N stream is detected as FLV, width/height are unconditionally set to 320×240 (lines ~1493-1494). The demuxFlv() function strips raw VideoData payloads but never parses codec-specific bitstream headers to extract actual frame dimensions. For Sorenson H.263 (codecId=2) frame size is encoded in bits 17-30 of the first video tag; for VP6 (codecId=4/5) it is in the deblock header bytes. Without real dimensions, DefineVideoStream is emitted with 320×240 causing Ruffle to scale/crop any video that isn't exactly that size. Fix: in demuxFlv() (packages/swf/src/video.ts), parse the first video frame's codec header to extract width/height and return them alongside the frames. Then use the real dimensions in flash8-import.ts instead of the hardcoded stub.
